Fixed a bug that was stuck in the character selection interface.
I'm very sorry, it's my problem. A repair patch has been released, please check it.

notes.content: Remove the logic of mandatory detection of SteamWorks initialization

notes.title: Update on July 20
notes.content:
Update on July 20,
The overall new rendering scheme is upgraded, and the overall picture effect is more delicate and realistic.
Integrating the real-looking DLC into the game itself, now there is no need to install the real-looking DLC separately, you can directly select the character style in the main interface of the game.
Model penetration repair of clothing.
Bug fixes, fixed a bug that caused data errors when entering the game before reading the steam achievements.
The card drop has been submitted for review, and there is a chance to get a new steam card during the game.

notes.title: Update August 28, 2020
notes.content:
Fix some bugs:
1. Adjusted the skill damage balance of some characters.
2. Modified the problem of wearing molds for most garments.
3. The rendering order of transparent clothing has been modified. Multi-layer transparent clothing can now be rendered correctly.

notes.title: 30 kinds of stockings added to the Clothes Expansion Pack.
notes.content: The Clothes Expansion Pack has been updated, adding 30 different kinds of stockings, each of which can adjust the color and have a damaged state.

notes.title: Update May 18, 2020
notes.content:
Fix some bugs:
1. Remove the debug information from the Z key on the keyboard.
2. The startup bug caused by different cloud archiving issues now adds the step of detecting the necessary files.
3. The initial 10 characters in the game can now be customized to modify the shape.
4. At the same time, in the game manual, the character display page has added the function of restoring the character's appearance.

notes.title: Clothes Expansion Pack have been released.
notes.content:
The Clothes Expansion Pack has been released and this DLC is the Costume Expansion Pack for the Fight Angel SE version, with over 80 brand new costumes built in, each of which can be modified in color, broken in combat, and applied to all characters.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app1298210][/url]

notes.title: Updated April 21, 2020.
notes.content:
Fix some bugs:
Adding dance tracks and dance moves, there are currently three tracks to choose from, and the dance animations are all different.
The Dance Club interface delays the UI appearance time so that no UI is brought to the screenshot.
Fixing the molded-in problem with some garments.
Fix the problem that you can't input the letter "I" when you name a custom character in the pinch screen.
Adjusted some of the costume's shattering effect and now the shattered state of the costume will be more apparent.

In addition, the new Costume Expansion Pack DLC is in the review stage and will go live soon. The DLC contains over 80 costume accessories, all color-adjustable, supporting all characters and with shattering effects.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: Realistic style character expansion pack has been released
notes.content:
The realistic style character expansion pack has been released, and we have decided to provide this upgrade project for free. The DLC provides a realistic-looking character similar to the original version, and players can choose to download it according to their preferences.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1222190][/url]

notes.title: Updated February 10, 2020
notes.content:
Fix some bugs:
Solved the problem that the joystick needs to be repeatedly inputted in the charge skills in battle.
The number of coins obtained after all battles will increase, which will speed up the acquisition of clothing.
Ninja underwear has returned.
Fixed the model error of some clothing.
Fixed the problem of excessive ambient sound.

In addition, the DLC of the realistic style character model has entered the review stage and will be launched soon. This DLC is an improved version of the original version of Fighting Angel, supporting all game modes including online battles.

notes.title: Fight Angel Special Edition Now Available
notes.content:
Fight Angel Special Edition is the remastered version with the anime cartoon style for the original Fight Angel. Newly custom modeling has been added, and some new content has been updated.

We wanted to give Fight Angel Special Edition to our previous Fight Angel players for free, so we're now requesting support from Steam. But we are a small indie team, it means that we need some time to solve it smoothly.

We're unsure when Steam support will give out free coupons to existing buyers. So if you can't wait until then, please contact us first. Find the purchase receipt for Fight Angel (1041400) Steam sent to you in the past and send it to our following email address. If we check it, we will reply you with the Steam game code for registering the Fight Angel Special Edition.

Red Fox Studio : zhoukh@163.com
